metadata.methods_description: Data were acquired using a 3 Tesla Philips Achieva dStream MRI scanner with 32-channel head coil. EEG was recorded at 5 kHz using 64-channel BrainAmp amplifiers (two 32-channel BrainAmp MRplus units) with hardware filtering (0.01-250 Hz). The 64-channel EEG comprised 63 head channels plus ECG. Additional physiological signals included 2 EOG, 4 EMG (Corrugator, Zygomaticus), and skin conductance channels. Auditory stimuli were presented via MR-compatible headphones. The category learning task comprised 180 trials with frequency-modulated sounds varying across five binary features (duration, frequency modulation direction, intensity, speed, frequency range). Participants indicated category membership via button press with trial-and-trial feedback. Resting-state fMRI was acquired for 10 minutes with eyes closed. Physiological signals (respiration, heart rate) were recorded at 100 Hz. EEG preprocessing included MR-artifact correction, bandpass filtering (0.3-125 Hz), and downsampling to 500 Hz. Raw data for optimized artifact correction are available upon request.
